# [TASK] Upgrade React 17 → 19 and migrate ReactDOM.render to createRoot

## Task
Install react@19 + react-dom@19. Run `npm run codemod:react18` (already wired). Manually fix any remaining usages of the legacy `ReactDOM.render` API in `src/index.js` to use `createRoot`. Fix any React 18/19 strict-mode double-invoke regressions.

## Parent Story
Parent: #123

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `npm ls react` shows 19.x. — `react@19.2.8`, `react-dom@19.2.8`.
- [x] `ReactDOM.render` not present anywhere in `src/`. — only remains as a code comment explaining the migration in `src/index.jsx`.
- [x] App renders correctly in dev and production. — verified with a headless Chromium smoke check against both `npm run dev` and `npm run build && npm run preview`: `#root` mounts real content (NavBar, Sidebar, Search, VoiceControl FAB), no React console errors/warnings, only expected TMDB network failures from this sandbox's lack of API egress.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
`npm run codemod:react18` is broken in this repo — it's wired to `@codemod/cli` 3.3.0, a different and older tool than the invocation it's configured to run. The one call site (`src/index.jsx`) was migrated by hand instead.

Bumped `@testing-library/react` 11 to 16, `jest-dom` 5 to 7 and `user-event` 12 to 14 (plus `@testing-library/dom` 10) as necessary collateral: the old versions call the removed `ReactDOM.render` internally and fail under React 19. `user-event` v14's API is async, so synchronous calls were updated to await. One `VoiceControl` test needs `{ pointerEventsCheck: 0 }` because MUI sets `pointer-events: none` on a disabled Fab.

MUI 5, react-redux 7, react-router-dom 5 and RTK 1.x are left for #129 and #130 — their React 19 peer warnings are expected until those land.

Commits: `96a66a5`, `5914b49`.
